title: Truly, the best drive tracking app
content: This is the best drive tracking app. It’s fully featured, gives you multiple ways to track your drive, you can track multiple vehicles in your garage, and it’s easy to setup and use. It’s also affordable. Great application and thank you to the developer👍
author: only_one_kenobi

title: Needs better documentation but great app
content: Still testing but changing my review. I have used a few of these trackers, last one was “Drivers Note” and they were highly expensive and decided to again increase their yearly price. My car uses CarPlay so does not track a trip via Bluetooth and this is the first app that works with CarPlay and so far has been great, even has a widget for the CarPlay stereo! The cost is good, all the options appear to be there and importantly, it just offers reliable simple tracking of trips for tax without a stupidly high cost. Will be investing in the lifetime sub if it keeps working as it has.
author: JesterMgee

title: Amazing!!

title: Love this app!
content: I use this app with CarPlay everyday. I never write reviews, but this is the best mileage app, reasonably priced and is easy to use. I highly recommend it, as it the most functional app on my phone.
